title: NEW MSFS 2024 PC Activities: Fly the Air Canada 747 Captain & JetBlue A320 Missions
description:
It’s March 15, 2026, and the MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update for the week is live — with the absolute must‑have headline for airliner fans being Perfect Flight’s 747 Captain – Air Canada (hello, heavy metal vibes 👀).

🗺️ New activities added this week (PC)
The following activity (missions & miscellaneous) was newly released in the marketplace this week:

🗺️ Perfect Flight: 4AIR MISSIONS – A320 JETBLUE (A320 JetBlue‑themed mission pack) 
🗺️ Perfect Flight: 747 Captain – Air Canada (Air Canada‑themed 747 Captain mission pack) 
🗺️ Perfect Flight: Adventure – Bering Sea & Gulf Of Alaska (Alaska‑focused adventure mission pack) 
🗺️ Koschi: Unique Places – Part 10 (Unique Places discovery‑style activity pack)

If this update helped you out, hit Like, Subscribe, and drop a comment — which of these are you flying first… the 747 Captain or the JetBlue A320 missions? 😄

Thanks for watching, happy flying, and ✈️ See you in the skies!
